reports.title: EPR Properties Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: (Dollars in millions, except per share data):

Current | Prior
Net income available to common shareholders per diluted common share | 3.41 | to | 3.49 | 3.03 | to | 3.19
FFOAA per diluted common share | 5.49 | to | 5.57 | 5.41 | to | 5.57
Investment spending | 675.0 | to | 725.0 | 600.0 | to | 700.0
Disposition proceeds | $86.0 | 50.0 | to | 100.0

The Company is increasing its 2026 earnings guidance for FFOAA per diluted common share to a range of $5.49 to $5.57 from a range of $5.41 to $5.57, representing an increase of 8.0% at the midpoint over 2025. The 2026 guidance for FFOAA per diluted common share is based on an FFO per diluted common share range of $5.50 to $5.58 adjusted for retirement and severance expense, transaction costs, provision (benefit) for credit losses, net, costs associated with loan refinancing or payoff and deferred income tax expense. FFO per diluted common share for 2026 is based on a net income available to common shareholders per diluted common share range of $3.41 to $3.49 plus estimated real estate depreciation and amortization of $2.54 and allocated share of joint venture depreciation of $0.05, less estimated gain on real estate transactions of $0.41 and the impact of Series C and Series E dilution of $0.09 (in accordance with the NAREIT definition of FFO).

Additional earnings guidance detail can be found on page 23 in the Company's supplemental information package available in the Investor Center of the Company's website located at https://investors.eprkc.com/financial-information/quarterly-results.
